actual_review.front: One very wide shallow petrol cross-frame, exactly two charcoal rectangular open fork mouths and two distant tan upper pads. Far locking ears are largely hidden in this projection; no third pocket or tall tower.
actual_review.side: The same shallow beam/pad and rear locking pin/ear profile remain connected. Laterally separated pockets/pads overlap in this orthographic axis view; one visible profile does not mean one pocket.
actual_review.rear: Two open rectangular pocket exits, two rear locking-ear/pin pairs and two distant upper pads connect to the same continuous cross-frame.
actual_review.three_quarter: Tangible shallow beam thickness, two open through-pocket mouths, two broad matte pads and two connected rear lock-ear/pin assemblies read as one object.
actual_review.context: A separate LONG-like bundle overhangs both pads on a contextual forklift; the close inset illustrates a fork entering a pocket. These are not measured engagement, load restraint, capacity or final vehicle-design proof.
actual_review.R06_comparison: Matte petrol/charcoal/tan, planar faces and small stepped bevels match R06 equipment. R06 remains vehicle authority, including tan forks; grey forks/simplified wheels in this R12 inset do not override it.
actual_review.iteration_fix: V1 numeric arrows implied metric height despite a visibly thick pocket/lock profile, with busy pad texture. V2 removes all numeric dimension arrows/labels, makes views visibly shallower and pads clean matte. Maximum height including pads/pockets/ears is controlled by the separate target JSON.
